load_entropy_model: load a ByteLatent entropy model from a checkpoint directory and state dict path onto a device
build_LMTransformerArgs: build an LMTransformerArgs config with dim, layers, heads, max sequence length, and vocab size
create_LMTransformer: create an LMTransformer instance from entropy model args with local block causal attention
review_load_state_dict: review how the entropy model loads its state dict from a torch checkpoint with strict mode disabled
test_eval_mode: test that the loaded entropy model is set to eval mode with gradients disabled
